verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official CLI on its integrations page. The CLI ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies and covers inbox creation, sending messages and thread management without writing code. A probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented install/auth flow and command reference depth, and evidence of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create inboxes, send messages, manage threads, and more — all without writing code. It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
